report.summary: The Give-to-Get Hypothesis aims to provide founders and indie developers with honest feedback on their projects through a reciprocal feedback mechanism. Users seek honest feedback, but existing channels do not provide it in sufficient volume and quality. Research supports the effectiveness of advising others in motivating participation and improving feedback quality. However, users express concerns about the reciprocity mechanic and the quality of feedback received.
recommendations: Conduct user interviews to validate the assumption that founders and indie developers need honest feedback and are willing to participate in a give-to-get feedback platform.
Develop a landing page or fake-door to measure interest and willingness to participate in the platform.
Consider implementing a quality control mechanism to ensure the quality of feedback received by users.
Pivot the platform to focus on a specific niche or industry where the give-to-get mechanism is more effective.
